# `foxglove event-types add`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](event-types.md)

```text
Create an event type

Usage: foxglove event-types add [OPTIONS] --name <NAME>

Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --color <COLOR>
          Color name, such as red

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --custom-property <ID[:required]>
          Custom property ID to attach, with a :required suffix if events must set it; repeat in display order

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

      --name <NAME>
          Event type name, unique within your organization

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
